text:
karim: deploy-bot flagged an embeddings quality/regression signal from customer telemetry (alpha-corp). p95 latency fine but similarity scores dropped ~12% vs baseline during canary. Not typical.

deploy-bot: ALERT: telemetry/alpha-corp | route=embeddings | quality_drop=12% | trigger_count=2 | auto_revert_threshold=2 | action=AUTOREVERT_SUGGESTED

nicole: i'm oncall for infra. This is different--quality, not latency. Auto-revert would swap models and could change embeddings significantly for the customer. we need human in the loop.

ops-bot: POLICY: For customer-observed quality regressions, autorevert is gated. Human hold can be set with `deploybot.hold=true`. Additionally, a two-approver unhold is required within change window for re-enable.

pat: setting hold now to prevent auto actions. `deploybot.hold=true` -> done. deploy-bot: hold acknowledged by pat at 4475019998.

mel: suggestion: instead of full revert, run a circuit-breaker degrade that routes only alpha-corp's traffic to the stable "v-lite" embedding variant (preserves other canary behavior). less blast, gives us time to RCA.

karim: can we do custom routing for a single account? yes via `infractl policy create --account=alpha-corp --route=embeddings --variant=v-lite --priority=account-override`. I'll prepare command.

nicole: also open ticket and CC account team. account-bot: AFFECTED: acct=AlphaCorp (canary-slice). Sales owner=@mel.

karim: executing command at 4475020005 -> `infractl policy create --account=alpha-corp --route=embeddings --variant=v-lite --note="circuit_breaker_quality_fallback"` -> API OK.

ops-bot: RUNBOOK: Circuit-breaker applied. Expected: immediate traffic diversion for account-only. Monitor quality metrics for 30m. If quality returns to baseline, consider controlled canary re-run after RCA.

deploy-bot: LOG: autorevert suppressed due to hold=true set by pat. account policy applied at 4475020005.

mel: messaging for AlphaCorp: "We've detected an embeddings quality anomaly affecting your canary slice. We've temporarily routed your requests to a stable variant and are investigating. No data exposure. Will provide updates within 30 minutes." posting to #customer-impact now.

karim: opened INC-2026-900, attached metric diffs, infractl history, and request to eng-ml for embedding similarity regression RCA. assigning eng-ml lead nicole. ETA 24h for initial findings.

nicole: quick checks: model weights same; candidate difference looks like a tokenization change in upstream preprocess. tagging preprocess team.

pat: adding deployment metadata: `rollback.account_scope=AlphaCorp`, `mitigation=circuit_breaker_degrade`, `operator=pat`, `start=4475020005`.

ops-bot: REMINDER: unsetting `deploybot.hold` requires two approvers now due to change window. Use `deploybot.unhold=true --approvals=2` or unset after RC.

mel: leaving hold. I'll coordinate with sales to notify AlphaCorp and propose a short call if they want more details.

karim: if eng-ml confirms preprocess change, next steps: either patch preprocess in canary or roll forward a controlled re-deploy with matching tokenization. We'll plan a controlled canary outside change window.

nicole: thanks team. keeping this thread pinned; reopen if deploy-bot shows any further telemetry triggers. pat: please keep hold until RCA complete.

pat: acknowledged. closing slack thread for now. ping @oncall immediately on any new alerts.
